info.title: Pinterest Pins API: Search, Boards and Profiles as JSON
info.description:
Public Pinterest pins from boards, profiles and keyword searches as JSON.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/pinterest-pins-boards (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Returns Pinterest pins by keyword, from boards, from whole profiles or by pin link: title, description, image and video file, destination link, saves, creator and board. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

boardUrls.title: Board, profile or pin links
boardUrls.description: Pinterest links: a board (pinterest.com/user/board/) returns the board's pins, a profile (pinterest.com/user/) every pin of that profile, a pin link that one pin with its counts, a search link the pins of that search.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Keywords to search Pinterest for, for example "home office ideas". Each query returns pins up to the limit below; Pinterest ends a search after about 900 pins.

urls.title: More links or usernames
urls.description: Further board, profile, pin or search links as plain text, or bare usernames such as "nasa" for a profile's pins.

maxResultsPerBoard.title: Maximum pins per board, profile or search
maxResultsPerBoard.description: Pins to save for each board, profile and search, up to 10,000. A request returns 20 rows at most.

includeDetails.title: Comments, shares and repins
includeDetails.description: Reads each pin's own record as well: number of saves, comments, shares and repins, the full description and the pin's first creator. One more request per pin. Board pins already carry saves and repins without it.

201.description: The results, one object per row.
